_meta.description: The 2026 MLB postseason, resolved as far as MLB has actually published it. DATES are official and machine-readable from the MLB Stats API. FIRST-PITCH TIMES are NOT published yet - every one of these games is currently served by the API with the 07:33:00Z sentinel (an impossible 03:33 ET start), which is MLB's own 'time not set' marker. Per MLB, game times are set once the matchups lock in the final weekend of the regular season. Nothing here invents or infers a time.
_meta.time_resolution_status: UNRESOLVED as of 2026-09-21 (session 2 re-verification) - no official first-pitch time exists for any 2026 postseason game: a fresh Stats API query returned all 53 postseason game records (2026-09-29 through 2026-10-31) and every one still carries the 07:33:00Z sentinel with startTimeTBD=true and seed-placeholder teams. MLB sets early-round times round by round once matchups lock on 2026-09-27; recent postseasons used roughly 2-4 p.m. ET and 7-8 p.m. ET windows, which this project does NOT treat as times. The engine blocks each official date with the full local-date TBD envelope, which is conservative rather than precise. See docs/IRREGULARITIES.md IR-02.
_meta.date_resolution_status: RESOLVED - the dates below are the exact dates the league schedule reserves for games, including 'if necessary' games. Note the gaps: 2026-10-02, 10-21, 10-22, 10-25 and 10-29 carry no game under any scenario (travel days). An earlier version of this project blocked 2026-09-29 through 2026-10-31 continuously, which over-blocked those five dates.

clinch_status.source: https://www.mlb.com/news/2026-postseason-teams (MLB's clinch tracker, read 2026-09-21; URL redirects to a related news article but retains the tracker text)
clinch_status.corrections_2026_09_21: Two fields were wrong in the 2026-09-20 snapshot and are fixed here: 'Tampa Bay Rays (AL East)' was listed as a clinched division - the Rays had NOT clinched the AL East (magic number 2 through Sep 20) and are re-listed as a berth only; the Braves' NL East title (Sep 20) was missing from the division list. See docs/IRREGULARITIES.md IR-32.

resolution_progress.division_titles: 3 of 6 clinched (verified: MIL NL Central, LAD NL West, ATL NL East). The AL East (Rays lead), AL Central and AL West remain open.
resolution_progress.wild_card_slots: AL: Yankees and Red Sox hold two of the three wild-card slots but seeds are not final. NL: Cubs/Padres/Phillies hold the three projected slots; none clinched as of 2026-09-21.
resolution_progress.matchups: 0 of 4 Wild Card Series set. No official matchup exists; MLB's own tracker notes Boston would 'likely' face the Yankees on the road, which is a projection, not a fixture, and this site does not store it as one.
resolution_progress.first_pitch_times: 0 set. Times are expected to be announced round by round after the field is fixed on 2026-09-27.
resolution_progress.what_clinching_does_resolve: The six berths cannot disappear from the bracket, and the five no-game dates stay no-game dates. Nothing else about a specific game is implied: a berth sets neither opponent, host, seed nor time.

clinch_status.still_unresolved: Seeds 1-6 in each league except the three clinched division winners' titles (seeds themselves still move), all matchups, and every first-pitch time. Any row on this site naming a specific club in a still-TBD postseason game would be a guess, so the site shows the league's reserved dates with participants TBD.
clinch_status.review_note: Re-read 2026-09-21 against MLB's clinch tracker and the Sept 20 playoff-picture standings. Corrected the Rays/Braves division list (IR-32). Berths do not establish opponents or first-pitch times. Session 2 re-read (same day): still exactly six berths - no new clinch between reads; the tracker text confirms the Wild Card Series begin Tuesday 2026-09-29 and that the two best division winners in each league get first-round byes. Link extraction redirects to a related article while retaining the tracker text; flagged previously as a redirect irregularity.
